subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses consonant blends to build up and break down words (r and l blends: bl-ack, fl-op, sl-ip)

show.line: Two sounds stuck together! bl, bl, black. fl, fl, flag. sl, sl, slip. Blends!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with fl, as in flag?
Listen. sl, i, p. What word is it?
Say the blend with me. bl, as in black!
Which one starts with cl, as in clap?
Listen. fl, a, g. Tap the word.
Does it start with bl, fl or sl? Sort the pictures.

hints: Say both sounds fast. b, l. bl!
Listen to the very start. Two sounds, not one.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with sl.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Flag starts with fl. Slide starts with sl.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. sl, sl, slide. Slide starts with sl!

parent_line: Can hear and blend the l blends bl, fl, sl and cl.
